role: PM feasibility validation before developer implementation

decision.summary: Narrative Service should use a four-layer source pyramid: trusted official facts, licensed timely news, public research/context sources, and social/community heat signals.
decision.developer_gate: Developer should only implement sources marked can_do, paid_trial_ready, or controlled_pilot after governance metadata is present.
not_ready_for_developer: Large-scale X/Weibo/Xueqiu/EastMoney Guba crawling without permission review
Paywalled or login-only source collection without a contract
Any source requiring CAPTCHA bypass, stealth browser, or residential proxy evasion

live_smoke_results.result: returned JSON with 1000 recent filing rows
rate limit response: one request every 5 seconds

source_matrix.name: Tushare news
source_matrix.pm_decision: first China structured news candidate because gateway already has Tushare context
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Confirm token entitlement and run permission smoke for src=sina/eastmoney/cls/yicai.

source_matrix.name: CNINFO announcements and data API surface
source_matrix.market_coverage: China A-share disclosures, funds, bonds, Hong Kong disclosure links, exchange/regulator links
source_matrix.api_or_access_path: Existing CNINFO announcement provider plus CNINFO data API review
source_matrix.pm_decision: anchor source for China narrative facts; PDF/content parsing should be a later controlled slice
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Define first official-disclosure narrative categories: policy reply, investment project, order/contract, M&A, capacity expansion, regulatory risk.

source_matrix.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and XBRL APIs
source_matrix.market_coverage: US-listed companies and foreign issuers filing with SEC
source_matrix.pm_decision: strong global official source for company-event narratives
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Map 8-K/10-Q/10-K/6-K forms to narrative event types and add CIK/ticker resolution.

source_matrix.name: Google News RSS
source_matrix.market_coverage: global web news, variable source quality
source_matrix.pm_decision: use for recall and evidence discovery, not as trusted fact
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Keep as fallback/context source and add source-domain quality labels.

source_matrix.name: Sina Finance rolling headlines
source_matrix.pm_decision: use for China headline recall after source-domain scoring
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Validate layout stability and add domain source health report.

source_matrix.name: Securities Times / STCN
source_matrix.api_or_access_path: Existing provider constants indicate planned/partial provider surface
source_matrix.pm_decision: good candidate for controlled public-web crawler pilot
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Review robots/TOS and run one-page parser smoke.

source_matrix.name: 同花顺 iFinD data API
source_matrix.market_coverage: China stocks, funds, macro, news/research depending entitlement
source_matrix.pm_decision: serious China-market paid candidate; useful if account/API entitlement is acceptable
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Contact/try iFinD with required endpoints: news, research, announcement tags, sector/concept events.

source_matrix.name: 东方财富 Choice
source_matrix.market_coverage: China stocks, funds, bonds, macro, research and data
source_matrix.pm_decision: evaluate against iFinD/Wind for China source coverage and API ease
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Request endpoint list and trial access for news, research, announcement tags, concept/sector events.

source_matrix.name: LSEG / Reuters News API
source_matrix.pm_decision: best candidate when professional global news reliability and metadata matter
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Ask sales/trial for redistribution, archive, China language coverage, and entity metadata terms.

source_matrix.name: RavenPack / Bigdata.com news analytics
source_matrix.market_coverage: global news and social sources with entity/event analytics
source_matrix.pm_decision: high value if we buy event/entity/novelty metadata instead of rebuilding it
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Trial entity/event taxonomy fit against our narrative taxonomy.

source_matrix.name: Benzinga APIs
source_matrix.market_coverage: primarily North America / global market news products
source_matrix.pm_decision: good fast global/news prototype source; less ideal for China A-share primary coverage
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Test whether plan includes full text, historical archive, ticker tags, and redistribution permission.

source_matrix.name: GDELT
source_matrix.pm_decision: use for global discovery only after queue/cache/pacing; smoke hit 429
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Design one-request-per-5s queue and cache before any implementation.

source_matrix.name: Stocktwits public/Firestream
source_matrix.market_coverage: US stocks, ETFs, crypto social discussion
source_matrix.api_or_access_path: Public symbol endpoint for recent smoke; Firestream for authorized streaming
source_matrix.pm_decision: good social heat candidate, not a fact source
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Clarify permitted public endpoint use and paid Firestream pricing/terms.

source_matrix.name: Reddit API
source_matrix.pm_decision: only use selected finance subreddits for heat/candidate discovery
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Define allowed subreddits, query terms, rate limits, and storage/excerpt policy.

source_matrix.name: X API
source_matrix.api_or_access_path: X API recent search / full archive / counts
source_matrix.pm_decision: do not crawl X; use official paid API only if social heat becomes necessary
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Defer until narrative digest needs global social acceleration.

source_matrix.name: Xueqiu / EastMoney Guba / Weibo
source_matrix.market_coverage: China retail investor discussion and social media
source_matrix.api_or_access_path: official/commercial API if available; compliant public-page pilot only after review
source_matrix.pm_decision: do not assign to developer until permission and risk review are done
source_matrix.next_pm_action: Investigate official/commercial access and robots/TOS; treat as heat only.

recommended_next_actions.action: Run paid-provider contact/trial checklist for iFinD, Choice, LSEG/Reuters, RavenPack, and Benzinga.
Define the first 20 narrative event types that official disclosures should generate.
Freeze source registry fields and source-event schema v2 before any crawler or paid provider implementation.
After PM/Architect gates, implement can_do sources first: SEC EDGAR, CNINFO category expansion, Google/Sina/STCN source quality labels, then controlled Stocktwits/GDELT pilots.
